'''Christophsians''' were the [[Human/Legends|humans]] who were native to [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]].

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Christophsians-defend-their-home.png|thumb|left|200px|Christophsians attempt to repel Separatist battle droids.]]

Christophsians were brown-skinned Humans. Some had facial markings.

==History==
Christophsians had an indifferent existence on a useless [[Planet/Legends|planet]] until around [[600 BBY/Legends|600 BBY]], a family of [[Tepasi/Legends|Tepasi]] nobles made the investments necessary to transform the [[Christoph system/Legends|Christoph system]] into a worthwhile [[Mining/Legends|mining]] concern. Over the course of a century, Christophsians hired [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] to protect the planet from the stray [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] of the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] and refined technologies to make use of the asteroids. The Christophsians' investment in the aliens' services paid off and the system's richness in raw materials eventually transformed it into a mining haven. They renamed the system to "Christoph" in their own honor.

As the arrogant Oligarchs enjoyed admiration for their mining expertize and careful marketing manipulation, life on Christophsis passed in quiet indulgence, secrecy and self-absorption. Operating in a caste system, menial work was done by alien immigrants who were virtual prisoners and household needs were catered by "lower" humans. Sometime during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Christophsians were contacted by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] forces and the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Army of the Republic]]. The Separatists invaded their planet, and the Christophsians mounted a defense, but were ultimately forced to appeal to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] for help.
